description: Composition and layer markers (Layer > Add Marker, the Marker dialog): list, add (or set a numbered composition marker 0-9), edit comment, duration, chapter, web link, cue point, label and protected region, remove one or all, move the current time to a marker, or Update Markers From Source. Give layers for layer markers; omit them for composition markers

action.description: list, add, update, remove, remove_all, go_to, update_from_source (layers whose source has markers)

at.description: add: where to put the marker; update, remove, go_to: the marker at this time. Seconds, or "current_time" (the default), "comp_start" or "comp_end"

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

eventCuePoint.description: Cue point type: true event, false navigation

layers.description: Layer markers on these layers; omit for composition markers. Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

marker.description: update, remove, go_to: the marker's number in time order (1 = first), instead of at

number.description: Composition markers: the numbered marker 0-9 (add moves it if it exists; update, remove, go_to find it)

parameters.description: Cue point parameters, name to value

protectedRegion.description: Protected region (composition markers with a duration)

name: edit_markers
title: Edit Markers
